Definition: green, i.e. a young ear of grain; hence, the name of the month Abib or Nisan
BiblicalUsage: Abib is the month of green ears of grain — the first month, the month of the Exodus. ‘This day came ye out in the month Abib’; and Moses tells Israel to ‘observe the month of Abib, and keep the passover unto the LORD thy God: for in the month of Abib the LORD thy God brought thee forth out of Egypt by night.’
TheologicalSignificance: The year starts with green grain and a night escape — the calendar itself remembers the Exodus — and I believe God marks time by redemption, dating every year after from freedom.
RelatedEvents: The Passover; The Exodus and the Red Sea
